# King of Detailing
> Premium mobile car detailing service in Luton, Bedfordshire, UK

## About
King of Detailing is Bedfordshire's elite mobile car detailing service, delivering fully insured, studio-grade perfection directly to your driveway. We are an officially accredited Garage Therapy Professional — a certification held by only a select number of detailers across the UK.

## Services
- **Deep Clean** (from £150, 5–6 hours): Full interior & exterior detail
- **Maintenance Clean** (from £100, 3–4 hours): Regular scheduled care every 3–6 weeks
- **Enhance — Paint Correction + Ceramic Coating** (from £650, 1–1.5 days): Machine polishing + 3-year ceramic coating
